entities.summary: Daniel Weston Worth is an American baseball coach and former professional baseball infielder. He is an assistant baseball coach at Pepperdine University. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Detroit Tigers and the Houston Astros, and in the KBO League for the SK Wyverns.
